outcome: Seropositive rates of HBsAg in children at birth
HBV infection rates at 9-15 months of age
cohort: A total of 305 children (176 born with assisted conception and 129 with natural conception) were born to 251 hepatitis B surface antigen- (HBsAg-) positive women.
finding: Assisted conception does not significantly increase the risk for mother-to-child transmission of HBV compared with natural conception.
